_comment: This file holds what JJ Flexible says and shows, for audio and DSP - devices, levels, transmit audio, filters, meters and transmit safety. EDITING: change the text on the right of the colon; never change the key on the left, and never change anything inside curly braces such as {radio} - those are filled in at run time with the actual radio name, frequency and so on. If an argument goes missing the placeholder is left standing rather than blanked, so you would hear the word radio in braces spoken aloud - that is a bug worth reporting, not something you caused. A key with no text is spoken as the key itself, so if you hear something like connect.radio_found read out literally, that key needs text. LADDERS: a few keys hold several tiers instead of one string - critical, terse, chatty and sometimes diagnostic - which is how one message gets shorter as you turn verbosity down. Edit the tier you want; leave the others alone. YOUR OWN COPY: put a file of this same name in the lexicon folder beside your settings and it layers on top of this one, key by key - you only need the keys you want to change, and everything else keeps working. If your file has a typo in it, it is ignored and this one is used, so a mistake can never stop the program. SOME WORDS ARE ALSO INSTRUCTIONS: a handful of these strings are matched by the program to decide what to do next, so editing them can change behaviour rather than only wording. Those are being untangled; until they are, if something stops working after an edit, that is why. See docs/planning/active/string-store-contract.md.

audio.iq.idle.text: Ready for a receive-only diagnostic take. Off-air audio checks need two receivers and a transverter arrangement.

audio.iq.rate_help.text: 24 kHz preserves voice timbre. Choose 48 kHz for comparison; 24 kHz is not a fine spectral measurement. 96 kHz is available for diagnostics.

audio.iq.separate_pan.text: Create a separate listening pan for this diagnostic

audio.iq.full_duplex.text: Full duplex on for this diagnostic

audio.iq.antenna_help.text: Choose an antenna for a separate listening pan. The transmit slice antenna is left alone.

audio.iq.capacity_optional.text: The ten-second IQ capacity check is optional and runs only when you press its button.

audio.iq.one_scu.text: This radio has one receiver. Its IQ stream has not been confirmed to survive transmit. Receive-only diagnostic takes are available; automatic off-air audio checks are not.

audio.iq.preparing.text: Preparing the take. Waiting for active radio data, the echoed rate and the payload check. Press again to cancel.

audio.iq.recording_diagnostic.text: Diagnostic recording. Radio status is active, the requested rate is echoed, and the payload check passed. This recorder keys nothing and continues through your own keying.

audio.iq.stop_other.text: Stop the other check or take before starting this one.

audio.iq.finishing.text: Recording stopped. Finishing the take and restoring the radio.

audio.iq.corrupt.text: Take refused: the {check} integrity check failed.

audio.iq.diagnostic_result.text: Diagnostic {state}. Duration {seconds} seconds. Receive antenna {antenna}, RF gain {gain}. Sample count divided by wall-clock expectation: {ratio}. Gaps: {gaps}. Payload verdict: {classifier}. A clean instrument should be within one percent of 1, with no gaps beyond a recorded start-up signature.

audio.iq.preflight_running.text: Checking IQ capacity at 24 kHz for ten seconds, without keying. Press the capacity button again to cancel.

audio.iq.preflight_clean.text: The ten-second IQ capacity check passed at 24 kHz: sample count within one percent of wall time and no gaps beyond a recorded start-up signature. Off-air takes are available on a supported two-receiver radio.

audio.iq.preflight_loss.text: The IQ capacity check was not clean enough for a reliable off-air take. Try Record and play back. The diagnostic header records the measured sample ratio, gaps and jitter.

audio.iq.recovery_offer.text:
A previous IQ take on radio {serial} did not confirm restoration. The saved prior settings and owned resources follow. Restore now attempts these changes and keeps this record until restoration is confirmed.
{changes}

audio.iq.creation_uncertain.text: Resource creation was interrupted before its identity was confirmed. Inspect the radio layout; automatic recovery will retain this record rather than guess which resource to remove.

audio.iq.restored.text: The radio confirmed restoration. The recovery record has been cleared.

audio.iq.recovery_pending.text: Radio restoration is not fully confirmed. The saved recovery record is retained. Review unrestored take settings. After reconnect, reused slice or pan identities require manual inspection; they are never changed by guesswork.

audio.iq.no_recovery.text: No unrestored take settings were found.

audio.iq.reason.unexpected.text: an unexpected error occurred; details are in the trace.

audio.iq.reason.radio-busy.text: the radio is transmitting or another loopback is active.

audio.iq.reason.recovery-pending.text: the previous radio settings need restoration first.

audio.iq.reason.one-scu-not-confirmed.text: this radio has one receiver and transmit survival is unconfirmed.

audio.iq.reason.no-transverter-port.text: the radio does not list a transverter transmit port.

audio.iq.reason.smartlink-iq-unavailable.text: IQ isn't available over SmartLink; connect locally or over a VPN.

audio.iq.reason.ssb-only.text: off-air playback currently requires USB or LSB.

audio.iq.reason.unsupported-rate.text: this radio does not list that IQ rate.

audio.iq.reason.no-free-slice.text: no slice slot is free for the listening pan.

audio.iq.reason.antenna-change-requires-.text: changing receive antenna requires a separate listening pan.

audio.iq.reason.pan-iq-in-use.text: the listening pan already has an IQ binding.

audio.iq.reason.no-transmit-pan.text: the transmit slice has no pan.

audio.iq.reason.arrangement-refused.text: the loopback arrangement could not be made.

audio.iq.reason.listening-pan-not-create.text: the new listening resources could not be identified.

audio.iq.reason.no-other-transverter-inp.text: the radio does not list a second transverter receive input.

audio.iq.reason.receive-antenna-unavaila.text: the requested receive antenna is not in the radio list.

audio.iq.reason.no-stream-status-within-.text: the radio did not acknowledge the IQ stream.

audio.iq.reason.no-stream-create-reply.text: the radio did not reply to the IQ stream request.

audio.iq.reason.stream-create-refused.text: the radio refused the IQ stream request.

audio.iq.reason.no-active-stream-at-conf.text: active data at the requested echoed rate did not arrive.

audio.iq.reason.smartlink-no-iq.text: the radio sent no IQ data over SmartLink. The vendor does not support IQ over SmartLink in this path; the take header records zero routed packets and payload bytes.

audio.iq.reason.classifier-not-ready.text: the payload check did not pass.

audio.iq.reason.repeating-pattern.text: the IQ payload repeats a pattern instead of carrying usable radio data.

audio.iq.reason.non-finite-payload.text: the IQ payload contains invalid numbers.

audio.iq.reason.rate-request-refused.text: the radio refused the requested IQ rate.

audio.iq.reason.unexpected-payload-endia.text: the radio reported an unexpected payload byte order.

audio.iq.reason.stream-state-or-rate-cha.text: the IQ stream became inactive or changed rate.

audio.iq.reason.preflight-required.text: the IQ capacity check has not passed.

audio.iq.reason.dummy-load-active.text: Dummy Load mode is active. Off-air checks require the deliberate one-watt transverter arrangement.

audio.iq.setting.slice-mute.text: Receive slice mute before the take

audio.iq.setting.ears-rf-gain.text: Listening slice RF gain before setup

audio.iq.setting.ears-mute.text: Listening slice mute before the off-air take

audio.iq.setting.pan-iq-channel.text: Pan IQ channel before the take

audio.iq.listen_method.text: Off the air, then play back

audio.iq.detune_plus.text: Prove it is real: play one kilohertz higher tuning

audio.iq.detune_minus.text: Prove it is real: play one kilohertz lower tuning

audio.iq.keyed_line.text: Off-air take at {freq}, one watt into the transverter port, source {source}. IQ is recording; playback follows stop. This internal coupling is not a calibrated antenna measurement.

audio.iq.recording_offair.text: Off-air take recording. Stop Audio Check or Escape stops transmission through the safety controller; playback follows restoration.

audio.iq.take_result.text: Take {state}, {seconds} seconds, received on {antenna} at gain {gain}. Gaps: {gaps}. Sample count ratio: {ratio}.

audio.iq.startup_signature.text: Start-up signature detected: four filled sample pairs at the first packet boundary.

audio.iq.offair_removing_listener.text: Off-air take: removing the listening slice.

audio.check.loopback_adding_ears.text: Loopback Check: adding a listening slice.

audio.check.loopback_removing_ears.text: Loopback Check: removing the listening slice.

audio.iq.never_keyed.text: No transmitted take: the radio never reported keying. The diagnostic IQ was retained.

audio.iq.playing_incomplete.text: This take is incomplete. Playing the trustworthy samples with missing spans left silent; measurements cannot cross those spans.

audio.iq.playing_detuned.text: Playing the same IQ with a shifted tuning. Listen for the pitch change.

audio.iq.no_take.text: No rendered IQ take is available.

audio.iq.reason.keying-refused.text: the safety controller did not key the radio.

audio.iq.reason.unsupported-render.text: this take is not a supported USB or LSB render.

audio.iq.compare_previous.text: Compare the last two IQ takes

audio.iq.auto_compare.text: Tell me how my sound changed compared to my last take

audio.iq.auto_unavailable.text: I can't compare this take with the last one under matching conditions.

audio.iq.same_level_tone.text: Your new take has the same level and the same tone as your last take.

audio.iq.level_changed_tone_same.text: Your new take is {level_word} by {level} dB than your last take, with the same tone.

audio.iq.level_same_tone_changed.text: Your new take has the same level as your last take but sounds {brightness_word}, with highs {high_word} relative to lows by {tilt} dB.

audio.iq.level_and_tone_changed.text: Your new take is {level_word} by {level} dB than your last take and sounds {brightness_word}, with highs {high_word} relative to lows by {tilt} dB.

audio.iq.all_measures_same.text: Your new take has the same level and the same tone as your last take; its punch is unchanged, and its out-of-filter energy is unchanged.

audio.iq.reference_same_level_tone.text: The received audio has the same level and the same tone as what was sent.

audio.iq.reference_level_changed_tone_sa.text: The received audio is {level_word} by {level} dB than what was sent, with the same tone.

audio.iq.reference_level_same_tone_chang.text: The received audio has the same level as what was sent but sounds {brightness_word}, with highs {high_word} relative to lows by {tilt} dB.

audio.iq.reference_level_and_tone_change.text: The received audio is {level_word} by {level} dB than what was sent and sounds {brightness_word}, with highs {high_word} relative to lows by {tilt} dB.

audio.iq.reference_all_measures_same.text: The received audio has the same level and the same tone as what was sent; its punch is unchanged, and its out-of-filter energy is unchanged.

audio.iq.statistics_help.text: Select text and press Control+A, then Control+C to copy all measurements.

audio.iq.statistics_empty.text: Take measurements will appear after a take.

audio.iq.aligned.text: Content alignment measured a loop delay of {ms} milliseconds. Confidence and each gap-free span are in align.txt.

audio.iq.not_aligned.text: The reference and received audio could not be aligned confidently. No audio differential is reported. A steady tone is ambiguous by whole cycles; align.txt records the refusal.

audio.iq.sent_unavailable.text: No usable PC transmit reference is available. The radio microphone jack has no sent.wav in this build.

audio.iq.tone_identified.text: Keyed tone identified at the predicted {hz} hertz offset, {db} decibels above the resting floor.

audio.iq.tone_not_identified.text: The expected tone was not positively identified. Predicted offset {hz} hertz, measured rise {db} decibels; the threshold is twenty. Check instrument status before drawing a radio conclusion.

audio.iq.playing_sent.text: Playing the PC audio after source injection and conditioning, before Opus.

audio.iq.need_two.text: Two rendered IQ takes are needed for this comparison.

audio.iq.previous_comparison.text: The newest take compared with the previous take.

audio.iq.compared_aligned.text: Compared sample for sample over aligned keyed audio.

audio.iq.compared_average.text: Compared by overall average over keyed, gap-free audio.

audio.iq.unlike_or_unaligned.text: These takes have different receiving conditions or too little gap-free keyed audio for a comparison. No numerical comparison was made.

audio.iq.unlike_source.text: This take used {current} and your last take used {previous}, so I didn't compare them. Make another take with {current} and I'll compare the two.

audio.iq.setup_filter.text: Your transmit filter was {previous_low} to {previous_high} hertz on your last take and is {current_low} to {current_high} hertz on this one.

audio.iq.setup_power.text: Your RF power was {previous} watts on your last take and is {current} watts on this one.

audio.iq.setup_profile.text: Your microphone profile was {previous} on your last take and is {current} on this one.

audio.iq.setup_mic_input.text: Your microphone input was {previous} on your last take and is {current} on this one.

audio.iq.setup_pc_microphone.text: Your computer microphone was {previous} on your last take and is {current} on this one.

audio.iq.reason.arrangement-not-confirme.text: the radio did not confirm the transverter antenna, one-watt power, full duplex and monitor-off arrangement. No automatic keying was attempted.

audio.iq.reason.tx-antenna-setup-unconfi.text: the radio did not confirm the transverter transmit antenna; no automatic keying was attempted.

audio.iq.reason.rf-power-setup-unconfirm.text: the radio did not confirm one-watt RF power; no automatic keying was attempted.

audio.iq.reason.monitor-setup-unconfirme.text: the radio did not confirm monitor off; no automatic keying was attempted.

audio.iq.reason.slice-mute-setup-unconfi.text: the radio did not confirm muting an existing slice; no automatic keying was attempted.

audio.iq.reason.full-duplex-setup-unconf.text: the radio did not confirm full duplex; no automatic keying was attempted.

audio.iq.reason.xvtr-drive-setup-unconfi.text: the radio did not confirm transverter drive attenuation; no automatic keying was attempted.

audio.iq.reason.arrangement-connection-e.text: the radio connection changed during setup; no automatic keying was attempted.

audio.iq.listen_method_help.text: Monitor plays the radio monitor. Record and play back records processed audio. Off the air, then play back receives your signal as IQ and plays it after you stop, using the two-receiver transverter arrangement. It requires one watt; Dummy Load mode must be off.

audio.iq.reason.command-queue-stalled.text: The radio command queue did not run the request within ten seconds. Preparation stopped; this was not an operator cancellation.

audio.iq.unreadable_offer.text: The saved take recovery record cannot be read or does not match this radio. No saved commands can be trusted. Inspect and restore the radio settings yourself before acknowledging. Acknowledging preserves this exact file for review and allows new takes; it does not claim that the radio was restored.

audio.iq.unreadable_acknowledge.text: I inspected the radio; preserve the unreadable record and allow new takes

audio.iq.unreadable_archived.text: The unreadable record was preserved for review. New takes are allowed. No radio settings were restored by this action.

audio.iq.reason.listening-state-not-conf.text: the radio did not confirm the listening slice and pan settings. Preparation stopped.

audio.iq.reason.listener-command-refused.text: the radio refused a listening frequency command. Preparation stopped; the take header has the command and reply.

audio.iq.reason.listener-command-timeout.text: the radio did not answer a listening frequency command. Preparation stopped; the take header has the command.

audio.iq.reason.full-duplex-refused.text: the radio refused full duplex. Preparation stopped.

audio.iq.recovery_state_unknown.text: The saved recovery state could not be read. Review unrestored take settings; no claim of restoration can be made.

audio.iq.ack.offer.text:
Restoration could not be fully confirmed for radio {serial}. The take requested the changes listed below. Some may already have been restored. Inspect the radio and correct anything you want to change, then choose I've checked, clear it. This clears the recovery record without sending anything to the radio. It preserves the record for review and allows new takes; it does not confirm restoration.
{changes}

audio.iq.ack.cleared.text: The recovery record was cleared after your inspection and preserved for review. No commands were sent to the radio by this action. New takes are allowed; restoration was not confirmed.

audio.iq.ack.changed.text: The record changed or a take is still running. It was not cleared. Review the current unrestored take settings again.

audio.iq.ack.creation_unknown.text: A resource creation was requested but its identity was not recorded. Check for an extra slice, pan or IQ stream.

audio.iq.ack.created.text: The take requested an extra {target}. Its current presence cannot be checked.

audio.iq.ack.not_recorded.text: a value not recorded in this older recovery file

audio.iq.ack.listener_request.text: The extra listener was requested as slice {slice}, pan 0x{pan}, at {frequency} MHz in {mode}, receive antenna {antenna}.

audio.iq.no_transmission.text: No transmission was recorded, so there is no transmitted audio to compare.

audio.iq.ack.present.text: A {target} with this ID is still present. Recovery removes it only if its ownership can be confirmed.

audio.iq.ack.absent.text: The requested {target} is already absent from the radio lists. No removal is needed.

audio.iq.review_absent.text: {setting}, ID {id}: already absent; no removal needed.

audio.iq.review_present.text: {setting}, ID {id}: still present; recovery checks ownership before removal.

audio.iq.review_unknown.text: {setting}, ID {id}: current presence cannot be checked.

audio.full_duplex.not_reported.text: Full duplex: not reported by the radio

audio.full_duplex.help.text: Full duplex applies to the whole radio. Press this button, or the JJ key Ctrl+J followed by Ctrl+X, to toggle it. The displayed state changes when the radio accepts the command. A LAN check speaks only if the radio reports a different state.

audio.full_duplex.blocked.text: Full duplex was not changed because Change Nothing is on.

audio.full_duplex.pending.text: A full duplex request is still waiting for the radio.

audio.check.loopback_setup_unconfirmed.text: The Loopback Check could not confirm its radio settings. No automatic keying was started.

audio.check.loopback_no_other_port.text: The radio does not list a second transverter receive input

audio.check.loopback_restore_unconfirmed.text: Loopback restoration could not be confirmed. Check full duplex, transmit antenna and power.

audio.full_duplex.refused.text: The radio refused the full duplex change.

audio.full_duplex.disagreed_on.text: The radio reports full duplex on, but the accepted command requested off. Check full duplex on the radio.

audio.full_duplex.disagreed_off.text: The radio reports full duplex off, but the accepted command requested on. Check full duplex on the radio.

audio.full_duplex.unconfirmed.text: The radio did not confirm the full duplex change. Check its reported state.

audio.recorder.recording_loopback.text: Slice {letter}, the Loopback Check's listening slice, is recording what it hears off the air.

audio.recorder.already_recording.text: Slice {letter} was already recording, so that recording carries on.

audio.recorder.play_refused_transmitting.text: Slice {letter}'s recording can't play while you are transmitting.

audio.recorder.play_stopped_by_transmit.text: Slice {letter} stopped playing because you started transmitting.

audio.recorder.nothing_to_play.text: Slice {letter} has no recording to play yet.

audio.recorder.no_slice.text: You have no slice of your own to record on.

audio.recorder.not_your_slice.text: Slice {letter} is not one of your slices.

audio.recorder.record_unconfirmed.text: The radio did not confirm that slice {letter} started recording.

audio.recorder.record_stop_unconfirmed.text: The radio did not confirm that slice {letter} stopped recording.

audio.recorder.play_unconfirmed.text: The radio did not confirm that slice {letter} started playing.

audio.recorder.play_stop_unconfirmed.text: The radio did not confirm that slice {letter} stopped playing.

audio.recorder.nearly_full.text: Slice {letter} has recorded for almost two minutes. From now on the radio keeps only the most recent two minutes.

audio.fields.recorder_help.text: The radio keeps one recording for each slice, up to its last two minutes. Choose a slice here, then record it and play it back. It can be a slice you are not listening to. From anywhere, JJ key then Control R records the slice you are on, and JJ key then Control P plays it.

audio.recorder.failed.text: The recorder ran into a problem and could not do that. The diagnostic log has the details.

audio.recorder.computer_record_unavailab.text: Recording to a file on this computer isn't available yet.

audio.recorder.computer_play_unavailable.text: Playing a recording from this computer isn't available yet.

audio.recorder.computer_play_refused_tra.text: A recording on this computer can't play while you are transmitting.

audio.fields.computer_recorder_help.text: Record to file saves what the radio plays through this computer to a file. Play from computer plays your last recording, or the one you chose in your recordings. From anywhere, JJ key then Control Shift R records to file, and JJ key then Control Shift P plays from computer.
